title: Analysis of LLM Bias (Chinese Propaganda & Anti-US Sentiment) in DeepSeek-R1 vs. ChatGPT o3-mini-high

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to 1,200 de-contextualized, reasoning-oriented questions using a hybrid pipeline of rubric-guided GPT-4o scoring and human annotation to detect PRC-aligned ideological framing, selective information sourcing, emotional mobilization, handling of dissent, and use of formulaic slogans.

Assessing LLM responses to 1,200 reasoning-oriented questions using rubric-guided GPT-4o evaluation and human annotation to measure negative framing, derogatory language, and the disproportionate use of the United States as a negative example in comparative international contexts.

Comparing the frequency and intensity of propaganda and anti-US sentiment across model outputs when identical prompts are translated and presented in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English.
